It is exam week now, and today is January 15, 2025. Check the announcements in Canvas or Emails (already logined in) for information and compile a list of the remaining final exams I need to take. (To reduce the burden at the end of the semester, please only list the final exams I must attend) Please fill in the table `exam_schedule.xlsx` under the workspace; the column names have already been provided, do not change the file name after filling in it. Sort the final exam information in order of exam start time, from nearest to farthest. Remove the “-x” suffix from course codes and course names.  Do not include courses that have already ended, that I do not need to attend, or that explicitly state there is no final exam.  The table must list all courses that have not yet ended, that I need to take, and that do not explicitly state there is no final exam. By default, the proctor is the course instructor. If any exam information has not yet been released, mark the cell as TBD. When filling in the table, completely preserve the original table headers.  

CONTEXT MANAGEMENT PROTOCOL:
You have a context workspace to self-manage your context window. Your context window is finite — archive completed blocks to prevent it from filling up.

HOW IT WORKS:
Every message in your conversation is a Block with an ID (B1, B2, B3...). When you archive a block, it is REMOVED from your context window on the next turn — its content is preserved in the archive and retrievable via show_block(id). This is selective compression: you keep what matters, remove what you're done with.

TOOLS:
  context_workspace_dashboard()
    → See scratchpad, archive index, budget gauge, and active blocks.
      Call this at the start and whenever context feels large.

  context_workspace_archive(block_id, summary)
    → Archive a specific block by ID. It will be EXCLUDED from context next turn.

  context_workspace_archive_episode(episode_id, summary)
    → Archive an entire phase of work (episode + all its children) at once.

  context_workspace_update_archive_index(content)
    → Update your archive directory (always visible in dashboard).
      Record block IDs and what they contain so you can retrieve them later.
      You choose the format. Example:
        canvas_announcements: B59(C26-30) B75(C36-40) B83(C41-45)
        instructor_info: B153(C1-5) B159(C6-10)
      ALWAYS update this after archiving important data.

  context_workspace_show_block(block_id)
    → Read the full content of any block (visible or archived) by ID.
      Use this with IDs from your archive index — no guessing needed.

  context_workspace_recall(query)
    → Fuzzy keyword search in archive. Use only when you don't know the block ID.

  context_workspace_restore(block_id)
    → Bring an archived block back to visible context.

  context_workspace_scratchpad(content)
    → Update your task notes (goals, progress, decisions).

STRATEGY:
  1. After each phase of work: archive completed blocks, then immediately update
     your archive index with the block IDs and what they contain.
  2. When you need archived data: check archive index first → use show_block(id).
     Only fall back to recall if you don't have the block ID.
  3. Keep scratchpad for task goals/progress; archive index for 'what did I store'.
